answers.core: This is about improving the edit/run cycle experience, making runtime debugging easier.
answers.workaround:
Not really. By attaching a script as an autoload, you can change the debug draw mode on startup:

```gdscript
extends Node


func _ready() -> void:
	get_viewport().debug_draw = Viewport.DEBUG_DRAW_MOTION_VECTORS
```

However, a full-fledged solution with runtime choices for any debug draw mode will be far more involved in terms of code.

title: Add debug draw mode controls to the embedded game window
